title: Please, Please. Please Don't Trash Our Beaches
description:
Please, please, please, don't trash our beaches and bay! 🏖️ 

San Diego is a top destination for Memorial Day weekend, with more than 250,000 visitors and locals expected. These spaces are for everyone to enjoy, so please do your part and pack out what you pack in.

#SanDiego #MemorialDay #beach
